title: Artifact provenance ledger - static import/call-graph
premise_under_test: Every LOAD-BEARING v7 artifact (the ensemble/percentile/subset CSVs+JSONs the claims rest on) was produced by the rank-2 run_single path (I_ext[:] += total_pa*pA broadcast + single global SNARE syn.w *= factor), NOT by a higher-rank writer (phase_g_network_perturbation.apply_to_brain carrying per-neuron k2p_max schema).
env: python3 stdlib ast/regex/subprocess - static only, no brain.run()

G0_denominator_freeze.rule: The in-scope (load-bearing) artifact set is fixed BEFORE classification by a hash-locked grep-reachability predicate over the load-bearing claim docs. No post-hoc shrinking permitted.
G0_denominator_freeze.predicate: in_scope := every path matching regex (artifacts/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.(csv|json)) that is textually referenced by a LOAD-BEARING claim doc. Load-bearing claim docs are FROZEN here as: docs/v7_final_summary.md and docs/v7_preregistration.md. The candidate set additionally records the KNOWN SUSPECT artifacts/phase_g/phase_g_halothane_dose_response.csv regardless of reference, and its scope is decided by the predicate (in-scope iff referenced by a load-bearing doc).
G0_denominator_freeze.hash_lock: sha256 of each load-bearing doc + sha256 of this prereg.json are recorded in result.json; recomputed at run time and asserted unchanged-within-run.
G0_denominator_freeze.pass_condition: in_scope set is non-empty, fully determined by the predicate, and recorded with its members BEFORE any classification step runs.
G0_denominator_freeze.fail_condition: in_scope set is empty, or any member is added/removed by hand after classification begins.

G1_rank2_attribution.rule: 100% of in-scope artifacts must trace to the rank-2 run_single path by BOTH (a) call-graph reachability AND (b) schema fingerprint. contaminated_count must == 0.
G1_rank2_attribution.callgraph_criterion: The writer module of each in-scope artifact, via transitive intra-package import + module-level reachability, must reach run_single (or only re-analyze frozen rank-2 raw artifacts) and must NOT reach phase_g_network_perturbation.apply_to_brain / NetworkPerturbation.
G1_rank2_attribution.schema_criterion: RANK2-NATIVE := artifact columns/keys are QF-space outputs (qf_dose_*, predicted_EC50_uM, max_qf, fold_error, percentile, ec50, ci_*) and contain NONE of the higher-rank per-neuron fingerprint columns {k2p_max, complex_i_max, gaba_max, snare_max, nachr_max, glucl_max, hyperpol_pA}. HIGHER-RANK-NATIVE := contains any of those fingerprint columns.
G1_rank2_attribution.pass_condition: for EVERY in-scope artifact: callgraph==RANK2 AND schema==RANK2-NATIVE; contaminated_count==0.
G1_rank2_attribution.fail_condition: any in-scope artifact is HIGHER-RANK-NATIVE by schema, or its writer reaches apply_to_brain by call-graph; contaminated_count>=1 => that claim VOID-pending-rederivation.

G1b_untraceable.rule: Zero orphan/untraceable in-scope CSVs. An in-scope CSV with no identifiable writer module is an automatic FAIL (never pass-by-default).

expected_per_roadmap: ensemble/percentile/subset family CLEAN (RANK2-NATIVE, call-graph reaches run_single); phase_g_halothane_dose_response.csv is HIGHER-RANK-NATIVE (k2p_max schema, writer reaches apply_to_brain) BUT website-only / OUT-OF-SCOPE by the frozen predicate (referenced only by web_export_anesthesia.py, not by any load-bearing claim doc).
decision_rule: PASS iff G0 frozen-and-nonempty AND G1 contaminated_count==0 AND G1b untraceable_in_scope==0. Any single gate FAIL => block FAIL: a load-bearing number silently came from the richer operator (publishable provenance correction). HARD GATES ABSOLUTE - no reframe to PARTIAL.
